note: The Sley 2 working history before the public release. The public repository starts at a single root commit whose tree is the sanitized export of the archived tip; every commit listed here was archived before that root; the ones reachable from the tip are its history, and the rest are side branches kept in the same archive. The archive is a git bundle kept outside GitHub. Anyone holding it can verify this ledger: the bundle's sha256, and git rev-list --parents --all run against it, reproduce commits exactly.
